salmos.sub: He who fears God will be blessed in his family
e: Blessed is that one
What fear does he have in the Lord
And who walks the paths,
The ways of Yahweh.
From the labor of your hands
You will earn your bread
And happy, then, will you be,
And good will follow you.
Your wife, in your house,
It's a vine blooming.
Like olive shoots,
Your children will sprout.
Around your table,
Everyone will be together.
Here is the blessing that reaches
Whoever thus fears the Lord.
May the Lord bless you
From Mount Zion
And in Jerusalem, you see
All the good that will be
For the time of your days,
For the years of living!
Children of your children, see.
Peace be upon Israel!
From the bottom of an abyss, oh God,
I make my scream heard.
Watching from the high skies
In the pain of the afflicted poor.
But alas! How can I bear it
Your penetrating and pure gaze,
If you remember my crime?
With you, I know, is forgiveness
That is why I trust in you.
No one will call upon you in vain,
Because you're kind and pious.
Yes, I will call upon you alone.
In your grace I will wait,
Because I don't trust works.
Oh! How strong evil is in us!
But Grace is stronger.
If the penalty is harsh, and it is fatal,
God frustrated his threat,
For he wants to save the sinner
And to safely set it,
The course in light charts you.
With eagerness I await my Lord,
What a sad dawn night;
For my God is a God of love,
And the weak revitalize.
Before the Guardian of Israel,
God is wise, just, good, faithful,
My soul kneels and loves it!
On the banks of the rivers of Babylon, we settled.
Remembering Zion, we cry, we cry.
There in the willows, we hang all our harps;
For our oppressors asked us for joyful songs
From Zion, for they wanted to hear the songs;
But, in the land of strangers, it was impossible.
May my right hand dry out all
If I come from Jerusalem to forget,
If I come from Jerusalem to forget!
If I don't remember you, let my tongue cling to my taste,
If I do not prefer Jerusalem to rejoicing!
Remember the children of Edom, Lord, to be against them;
For of Zion they said: "Raze even the foundations!"
Babylon will be annihilated!
Whoever gives it to you, then the repaid will be blessed!
Of the harm you have done us, yes, great harm!
Happy is he who catches your children, who imprisons them,
To crush them all against the rocks!
Hallelujah! O my soul, glorify your Lord.
To the Lord, praise and glory, I will sing in my life.
Do not trust in principalities, nor depend on men.
The spirit flees from them, and to dust they return.
Blessed is he who has God as his true help
In the Lord, your hope will always remain.
God made earth, heaven, and sea, and everything in it.
He does justice to the oppressed, and will also be faithful.
He gives bread to those who are hungry: he will deliver the captives.
The Lord lifts up the weak, and the blind will heal.
The Lord loves the righteous; the pilgrim will keep them;
He watches over the orphan and the widow, but he will trouble the wicked.
Hallelujah! O my soul, glorify your Lord!
To the Lord praise and glory, I will sing in my lifetime.
Forever the Lord reigns, He will be an eternal king;
And Zion will gladly exalt their God.
Let us sing here, like the angels of heaven,
Who always radiant worship God!
The throne surrounding him gives him praise,
Thousands of voices, but only one love.
The angels in heaven we heard say:
"Yours, Lord, is all the glory and power!"
And we answered in a triumphant tone:
"Worthy is the lamb; he has overcome all evil!"
You died, Lord, to save the wicked:
With you, in Heaven, they will always reign!
Oh! Be blessed, beloved Jesus!
Lord, our life, riches, and light.
United, on land, at sea, in expanse,
Created beings will worship God.
To Christ Jesus your church will give
Eternal praise and the Cross will bless.
